Vanessa / Laura — quick operational update from SRE after a first-pass review:

- Confirmed elevated 5xx rate from 22:06:12 PDT to 22:21:58 PDT on the serving fleet backing the us-west-2 hostpool for model:redwood-small-v2. Aggregated 5xx rate peaked at ~13.1% for a 1-minute bucket.
- Preliminary cause: transient connection churn between the router layer and a small subset of inference nodes during a rolling kernel update; we have a follow-up runbook to validate.
- I ran an SLO query and exported the results (slo_query_results.csv). The query shows service-level error rate crossing the SLA threshold for the stated window.

What I need from HelixPay to complete an eligibility check and prepare evidence for a credit:
1) A list of HelixPay API keys affected (we can cross-reference request IDs in the attached helix_503_sample.log).
2) Any replayable request IDs / full request traces (if available) so we can correlate upstream timeouts.

Proposed RCA scope (first-pass):
- Timeline reconstruction (1 day)
- Root cause analysis & contributing factors (2 days)
- Mitigations and rollout safeguards (2 days)
- Final report (3 business days total; can be expedited to 1–2 days with priority)

If HelixPay confirms affected keys and requests an expedited RCA, we’ll prioritize evidence pull and provide a formal incident window confirmation suitable for a credit claim. Let me know if you want me to produce a condensed incident memo for your finance/legal team.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Next steps: please reply confirming the affected keys and whether you want an expedited RCA. I’ll coordinate the evidence pull and deliverables.
